FastQC-viz: Create Help

Source: R/create_help.R
create_help.Rd

Create help sections for each module

Usage

create_help(module_name)

Arguments

module_name

character, name of the module

Value

character, The HTML elements that compose the header

Examples

create_help("per_base_sequence_quality")
#> <div class="card-face card-back" id="help-per_base_sequence_quality">
